title: Craft totem by Finncel
description: fairly simple recipes for crafting a golden enchanted apple and an immortality totem
body: This data pack introduces exciting new crafting options for Minecraft, allowing players to create powerful enchanted golden apples and a Totem of Immortality. Craft a shining, enchanted golden apple that grants incredible buffs and resilience, perfect for challenging adventures. Additionally, craft the Totem of Immortality to ensure you can survive even the deadliest encounters. Enhance your gameplay with these rare and valuable items, making your survival experience more thrilling and rewarding.!
